# Test artifacts

**Current addon test release: [v0.2.2](https://github.com/PhaedrusXY/Arcane_Syntax/releases/tag/v0.2.2).** The artifact uses the exact name `arcane_syntax_unified-0.2.2.jar` and has internal version `0.2.2`. It is built reproducibly from the older 0.2.1 compatibility JAR, with corrected research positions and updated version metadata. The GitHub prerelease hosts the downloadable binary; the generated `dist/0.2.2/` directory is created by the packaging script and need not be committed.

Older 0.2.1 test filenames are historical. Future distributables use `arcane_syntax_unified-X.Y.Z.jar` only; put release descriptions in GitHub release notes and CHANGELOG.md.

The `0.2.1/` ZIP is the unchanged incremental test update supplied for the existing Eldritch Aeons 0.2.0 focus migration. It is not a complete modpack or a validated standalone release. The same overlay is expanded under `deployment/0.2.1/`.

See the root README and `docs/TESTING_STATUS.md` for later maintainer reports. The ZIP's internal readme/validation documents reflect its original build-time status. No new JAR was built during repository preparation.
